reply_text: @marcus.lindqvist The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Dana posted here in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The cause was one trailer showing up as two rows: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him by hand. Dana was handling it on our side and has the screenshots. That's the latest I can see, so I can't tell you whether it's still open.
